title: filosofos: with condition variables
summary: Dining philosophers with one mutex and a condition: eat only when both neighbours are not eating.
hints: Keep `state[i]` (`THINKING`, `HUNGRY`, `EATING`). To pick up: lock, `state[i] = HUNGRY`, `while (state[left] == EATING || state[right] == EATING) pthread_cond_wait(&cv, &m);`, `state[i] = EATING`, unlock.
To put down: lock, `state[i] = THINKING`, `pthread_cond_broadcast(&cv)` (somebody waiting may now be able to eat), unlock. No semaphores.
